exercise_box_breathing_desc: Regulate your breath in four stages: inhale, hold, exhale and wait. Increases mental balance.
exercise_box_breathing_step1: Take a deep breath in (4 sec)
exercise_simple_counting_desc: Focus on numbers while breathing in and out. Helps gather the mind.
exercise_simple_counting_step1: Breathe in counting from 1 to 4 (4 sec)
exercise_simple_counting_step2: Now exhale counting from 1 to 4 (4 sec)

exercise_awareness_step1: Feel the natural flow of your breath (4 sec)
exercise_awareness_step2: Let it go without changing (4 sec)
exercise_extended_exhale_desc: Short inhale, long exhale. This rhythm calms the nervous system.
exercise_extended_exhale_step2: Now exhale longer and calmly (6 sec)

exercise_diaphragm_step1: Draw breath into your belly (5 sec)
exercise_diaphragm_step2: Release slowly from your belly (5 sec)
exercise_equal_breath_desc: Balance your nervous system by equalizing inhale and exhale durations.
exercise_equal_breath_step1: Take an equal breath in (5 sec)
exercise_equal_breath_step2: Give an equal breath out (5 sec)
exercise_slowing_desc: Slowing the breath rhythm lowers heart rate and prepares for sleep.
exercise_slowing_step2: Exhale very slowly and long (8 sec)
exercise_body_awareness_desc: Focus on different parts of your body while breathing to release tension.
exercise_body_awareness_step1: Scan your body while breathing in (5 sec)
exercise_relaxation_desc: Creates a deep sense of relaxation and eases the transition to sleep.
exercise_energizing_diaphragm_desc: Deep diaphragm breathing gives energy to the body.
exercise_energizing_diaphragm_step1: Take a strong breath from diaphragm (5 sec)
exercise_morning_breath_desc: Start the day with deep and lively breaths. Boosts your morning energy.
exercise_morning_breath_step1: Breathe in the fresh morning air (4 sec)
exercise_day_start_desc: Breathe in with positive energy, exhale lightly. Prepares you for the day.
